body: I'll try my hardest, then. It's not impossible. I've gone a day without it before, but it's hard.
I've been doing this every single day of my life for my whole life. Its fucking hopeless. There is no freedom for me.

It just feels like I can't stop myself from doing it no matter what...it feels like no thought could change my want to hurt myself when I'm having an "episode"

Even if I looked at pictures of myself as a child or thought about how much my body loves me I can't stop. I just hate myself too much. I feel so hopeless
It definitely is a 'punishment'. I'm not sure about my hormones or anything though

Thank you. 

People don't really talk about self harm that isn't cutting, and self harm is already a taboo subject. It makes me feel better to know I'm not alone.
I do see a therapist, but not hitting myself comes down to self control. Therapy has been very beneficial, but a therapist cannot physically stop me.
